title: Benchmarking Self-Supervised Learning on Diverse Pathology Datasets
mechanism: Large SSL benchmark in pathology with 4 SSL methods; domain-aligned pretraining beats ImageNet, also at low labels; domain-specific augmentations help.
adaptation: Template for the benchmark's pretraining table: same backbone and fine-tune, ImageNet vs in-domain SSL vs general FM, several label fractions, plus E1.
evidence: R: consistent gains over ImageNet in linear and fine-tune evaluation, including nuclei instance segmentation.
